Vanilla 'protect Kris' redirect indexes hp[] by CHARACTER id (hp[2]=Susie,hp[3]=Ralsei) but assigns SLOT numbers (1,2). With a non-canonical party the chosen slot can be EMPTY: e.g. party [3,4,0] (Ralsei,Noelle): hp[3]>0 -> target=2 -> empty slot -> global.charinstance[2] is the never-created id 12129292 -> 'Unable to find instance for object index 12129292' in scr_damage (dmgwriter creation reads global.charinstance[target].x). Also silently depends on absent chars having hp 0. New block is slot/party based and identical to vanilla when party=[1,2,3]; when slot 0 is not Kris, damage is spread over all living slots instead of always hitting slot 0 (bullets default target=0).
Same defect in scr_damage_maxhp (used by obj_roaringknight_quickslash_big / splitslash in base, elec, violet, thorn, cyan; kaizo already has party-aware code).

Thorn's per-hit max-HP erosion maps SLOT->character by hard-coding target 0/1/2 = Kris/Susie/Ralsei. In party [2,4,0] a hit on Noelle (slot 1) would erode SUSIE's maxhp (and floor it at 110), a hit on Susie erodes Kris. Noelle has no orighp/restore logic, so she is intentionally left out (_tc==4 does nothing).

Defeat test is hard-wired to char ids 1,2,3. A party containing Noelle (id 4) whose Kris/Susie/Ralsei slots are absent (hp 0 <1) is declared defeated on the first frame of the first enemy turn (turntimer forced to 0, then scr_gameover / retry path) even while Noelle is alive. Kaizo already computes _hp[] by slot. Occurs twice per entry (turntimer reset + game-over trigger).

Kris's attack multiplier counts 'downed' allies via hp[2]/hp[3] < 0. Absent Susie/Ralsei have hp 0 (not <0), so Kris in a party without them (or with Noelle) is treated as 'both allies alive' and deals half damage (thorn: x1) forever. Replacement counts living NON-Kris party members: 0 alive -> vanilla 'both down', 1 -> 'one down', >=2 -> 'none down'. Identical to vanilla for party [1,2,3].

No-Hit mode hook. scr_damage_cache() is the first statement inside the `global.inv < 0` gate of scr_damage, scr_damage_maxhp, scr_damage_fixed, scr_damage_proportional (scr_damage_all/_manual/_all_maxhp only loop over those), i.e. exactly once per hostile hit that is not absorbed by i-frames, before any retargeting/armour/damage reduction (so zero/clamped damage still counts). Graze never reaches it (grazebox only does TP); scripted hp edits (items, gloom, drains, Kaizo/Violet scenes, Elec spark-menu self damage) never call it. The hub resets global.knight_hits=0 at fight start and polls it (AOE hits count once per living member).

Kaizo's end-of-fight (end_cutscene_version==1, char_change) code creates the missing Kris/Susie/Ralsei ONLY if !i_ex(obj_hero*), then positions them for the overworld cutscene. A ghost child object makes i_ex() true so no visible hero is created (ghost draws nothing). Destroy ghosts (marker var knight_ghost set in ghost Create) first.

battlecontroller/darkcontroller Create build havechar[]/charpos[] per CHARACTER (last slot wins), so a duplicate party [2,2,2] draws ONE status box (at slot 2) and the slot-0/1 turns have no raised box. Iterating slots and refreshing charpos[c] draws one box per slot; identical for unique parties.

Raise/lower animation state mmy[] was keyed by character id: with duplicate members the slots shared one value, each frame the current slot lifted it and the other slots dropped it again, so the active status box stalled part-way up and never animated. Keyed by slot (0-2, array already has 4 entries) every box animates independently; identical for unique parties.
